product_one_liner.value: nudge provides employers with a financial wellbeing platform that delivers impartial, personalized financial education to their employees.

pricing_page.notes: No pricing link is listed, /pricing returns a page-not-found message, and commercial options are provided after discussing requirements.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index contains financial wellbeing, benefits, company news and customer stories, rather than engineer-authored posts about building the product.

public_docs.notes: The site provides a public FAQ, but no public documentation, help-center or developer-portal link was found in its navigation or footer.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: No qualifying AI, ML or data-science title appears on the public jobs list.

model_provider.notes: No underlying model or model provider was identified after reviewing the AI page, FAQ, blog, privacy policy and Trust Center/subprocessors. The company brands its AI as numa.

compliance_certs.notes: Claims ISO 27001 accreditation and GDPR compliance; GDPR is a compliance claim rather than a certification.

last_funding.notes: Latest publicly identified investment: Kennet Partners growth capital. The amount was not publicly disclosed.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest publicly identified funding was the March 2021 Kennet investment, outside the requested 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A live Strategic Account Executive role is advertised for the U.S., fully remote.

launched_6mo.notes: On September 1, 2026, nudge announced personalized financial action plans that prioritize next steps and adapt to each employee's circumstances and progress.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: On October 15, 2026, nudge announced Debi Kesselring and Greg Goebert as Vice Presidents, U.S.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The privacy policy explicitly identifies HubSpot as a marketing platform receiving visitor data. This signals website marketing use, not confirmed adoption of HubSpot CRM.
